author: Brian Wilson
releaseNotes: 1.20.0 — Adds a per-vacuum toggle, 'Keep sweeping continuously...', that makes a rotation sweep ignore due-status entirely and keep working through the full rotation list on a loop (using free time to get ahead, not just catch up) instead of stopping once everything's merely caught up. Off by default, preserving the existing 'sweep through due rooms, then stop' behavior.
